observations.question: According to the July 2024 amendment, what is the two-wheeler purchase-subsidy rate, per-vehicle cap, vehicle limit and scheme period or funding limit?

result.answer:
Uttar Pradesh — source cutoff: 2026-09-23.

Prototype source review is pending; current availability and individual eligibility are not verified.

- Purchase‑subsidy rate for two‑wheelers: 15 % of the ex‑factory cost. [S1](https://invest.up.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/342_160724.pdf#page=1)
- Per‑vehicle cap: Rs 5,000 per two‑wheel‑er, with a total outlay ceiling of Rs 100 crore. [S1](https://invest.up.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/342_160724.pdf#page=1)
- Vehicle limit: up to 200,000 two‑wheelers may receive the subsidy. [S1](https://invest.up.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/342_160724.pdf#page=1)
- Scheme period/funding limit: subsidy is available for five years from 14 Oct 2022 or until the unspent amount of Rs 403.97 crore is exhausted, whichever occurs first. [S1](https://invest.up.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/342_160724.pdf#page=1) [S2](https://invest.up.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/342_160724.pdf#page=2)

observations.question: According to the November 2025 notifications, what road tax and registration fee exemptions cover pure EVs purchased and registered in UP during the fourth and fifth policy years? State the dates.

result.answer:
Uttar Pradesh — source cutoff: 2026-09-23.

Prototype source review is pending; current availability and individual eligibility are not verified.

- Pure electric vehicles (Pure EVs) purchased and registered in Uttar Pradesh are eligible for a 100 % exemption from the registration fee during the fourth and fifth years of the policy, i.e. from 14 Oct 2025 to 13 Oct 2027. [S6](https://upidadv.up.gov.in/upload/PublicationRequest/175128/TransportLKO071125Notification638981268565493689.pdf#page=3)
- Pure electric vehicles (Pure EVs) purchased and registered in Uttar Pradesh are eligible for a 100 % exemption from road tax during the fourth and fifth years of the policy, i.e. from 14 Oct 2025 to 13 Oct 2027. [S7](https://upidadv.up.gov.in/upload/PublicationRequest/175129/TransportLKO1071125Notification638981269934059065.pdf#page=3)

Sources:

- [S6: Uttar Pradesh — Pure EV registration-fee exemption: notification 21/2025/1270, PDF page 3](https://upidadv.up.gov.in/upload/PublicationRequest/175128/TransportLKO071125Notification638981268565493689.pdf#page=3)
- [S7: Uttar Pradesh — Pure EV road-tax exemption: notification 22/2025/1271, PDF page 3](https://upidadv.up.gov.in/upload/PublicationRequest/175129/TransportLKO1071125Notification638981269934059065.pdf#page=3)

sources.version_note: Only pure EV registration fee; bought and registered in UP during the printed periods, not a subsidy extension.
Only pure EV road tax; bought and registered in UP during the printed periods, not a subsidy extension.

UTTAR PRADESH SHASAN 
PARIVAHAN ANUBHAG-4 
No.21/2025/1270/XXX-4-2025/8(19)/2018 TC 
Lucknow; Dated : 05 November, 2025 
NOTIFICATION 
 For implementation of the Uttar Pradesh Electric Vehicle Manufacturing and Mobility 
Policy, 2022 (as amended, 2025) promulgated through Notification No. 73/2025/2201/ 77-6-2025-
1657900, dated 17.10.2025 of the Industrial Development Department, Government of Uttar 
Pradesh read with minutes of meeting dated 10.10.2025 of High Level Empowered Electric Vehicle 
Committee ( HLEEVC) as approved by competent authority,  and in  the context of the Standard 
Operating Procedure (SOP) issued by the Transport Department vide Government Order No. 
420/30-4-2023, dated 18 March, 2023 for the benefit/facilitation of exemption in road tax and 
registration fee on electric vehicles under th e Uttar Pradesh Electric Vehicle Manufacturing and 
Mobility Policy, 2022, and for specific implementation of recommendation of  HLEEVC in Item no 
2 of its above approved minutes,  in partial amendment to Notification no 21/2023/ 814/30 -4-2023-
8(19)-2018 TC dated 12-06-2023 issued to notify amendment to Rule 50  (Sub rule 5 and 6) of U.P. 
Motor Vehicle Rules 1998 (as amended in 2023), it is hereby specified that 100% exemption in 
registration fee will be admissible to eligible electric vehicles of different categories, as under:- 
(i)  Electric vehicles (EVs) purchased and registered in the State of Uttar Pradesh within three 
years from the date of notification of the Uttar Pradesh Electric Vehicle Manufacturing and 
Mobility Policy, 2022, ie from 14.10.2022 to 13.10.2025. 
(ii)  Electric vehicles (EVs) purchased and registered in the State of Uttar Pradesh during the 
fourth and fifth years of the effective period of the Uttar Pradesh Electric Vehicle 
Manufacturing and Mobility Policy, 2022 notified on 14.10.2022 , i.e. from 14.10.2025 to 
13.10.2027. 
Explanation: 
For the purpose of the above exemption, electric vehicles means only pure electric vehicles (Pure 
EVs). 
 
      By Order, 
 
 Khempal Singh 
Special Secretary
